integrity: The discriminant, resultant, Sturm counts, transition multiplicities, and \(\tau=8\) positivity checks are supported by an exact-rational standalone verifier. Literature comparisons are limited to inspected published/open sources and targeted database searches.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to Rozikov's reduced non-mirror \(q=5\) subcase (2.24)--(2.25) for tree order \(k=2\); it does not classify the full four-variable five-periodic system or Gibbs-measure extremality.
title: Sharp parameter partition for a non-mirror five-periodic SOS boundary-law branch
